title: Enlargement and reduction of a plane figure
summary: Apply enlargement and reduction to lengths, coordinates, perimeter and area.
objectives: Enlarge coordinates about a stated centre.
Distinguish linear and area scale factors.
Reverse an enlargement to recover original measurements.

blocks.text: For an enlargement with centre C and factor k, the image point lies on the line through C and the original point. Its directed displacement from C is multiplied by k.

sections.title: Worked example

prompt.text: Point P = (2, 3) is enlarged about the origin by scale factor 4. Find P′.

sections.verification_note: Check that every side and angle was matched in the stated corresponding order.

prompt.text: A 12 cm side is reduced by scale factor 1/3. Find the image length.

blocks.text: Write the correspondence first, use one consistent scale factor, preserve equal angles, and check whether a length, perimeter or area needs a linear or squared factor.
